name: @w6w-apps/maileroo
description: Send transactional, templated and bulk email, read delivery logs, statistics, domains, suppressions and templates, and run OTP verifications with Maileroo.

w6w.longDescription:
Maileroo is an email delivery platform with an SMTP relay and a REST API. This app sends a transactional email, an email rendered from a dashboard template, or a personalised batch of up to 500, optionally scheduled up to 21 days ahead, and lists or cancels scheduled emails.

It reads the account's plan and hourly/monthly usage, sending statistics, delivery logs (search by recipient, subject, tags or outcome, fetch the stored raw message, resend it), domains with their DNS-record status and analytics, templates and applications, and manages the suppression list. It also drives Maileroo OTP Verification: send a one-time code by SMS, voice, WhatsApp, Telegram or email, check the code the user enters, and read or cancel verifications.

A connection holds up to two keys, because Maileroo uses two credentials: a Sending Key for the Email API (the sending and scheduled-email actions) and a scoped Account API Key for everything else. Provide the one or both your workflow needs; each action's description says which.

Health checks report whether both API hosts answer and how much of the plan's hourly and monthly sending allowance is left.
